newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bodies of four youths found after French fire.
newsitem.headline: Bodies of four youths found after French fire.

text.p: The charred bodies of four teenagers were found in the basement of a block of council flats where a fire broke out late on Tuesday in the northern town of Revin, police said on Wednesday.
Police said they did not immediately know whether the youths had been killed by the fire or had been already dead when the blaze began. No further details were immediately available.
